summary.goal: Add builds and build_runs tables to forge.db with migration, and implement storage queries for build lifecycle operations.

acceptance_criteria.description: builds table created with migration: build_id PK, status, tiers_json, concurrency_limit, skip_completed, mode, workspace_path, error, timestamps
build_runs table created: build_id + run_id composite, plan_id, plan_version, tier, status, timestamps, FK to builds and runs
createBuild() inserts build record and returns it
createBuildRun() inserts build_run record linking a run to a build
getBuild() returns build with aggregated progress (runs per tier, completion counts)
updateBuildStatus() transitions build status
getBuildRunsByTier() returns all build_runs for a specific tier
getRecentSuccessfulRun(planId) returns the most recent completed run for a plan (for skip_completed)
listBuilds() with optional status filter and pagination
Migration is idempotent and safe to re-run

tables.builds: build_id TEXT PK, status TEXT NOT NULL, tiers_json TEXT NOT NULL, concurrency_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 5, skip_completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, mode TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_path TEXT, error TEXT, created_at TEXT, started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT
tables.build_runs: build_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_version INTEGER, tier INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT, PK(build_id, run_id), FK(build_id) → builds, FK(run_id) → runs

architect.pattern: Follows existing forge storage pattern — same BaseSqliteStorage, same migration approach, same converter pattern

steps.title: Add builds and build_runs table DDL to schema.ts
steps.description: Add CREATE_BUILDS_TABLE, CREATE_BUILD_RUNS_TABLE, and index definitions to storage/schema.ts. Add to MIGRATION_STATEMENTS array for idempotent application.

acceptance_criteria.description: CREATE_BUILDS_TABLE with: build_id TEXT PK, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','completed','failed','paused','cancelled')), tiers_json TEXT NOT NULL, concurrency_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, skip_completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mode TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_path TEXT, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT, completed_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL

CREATE_BUILD_RUNS_TABLE with: build_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_version INTEGER, tier INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','completed','failed','skipped')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (build_id, run_id), FOREIGN KEY (build_id) REFERENCES builds(build_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
Index: idx_builds_status ON builds(status)
Index: idx_build_runs_build_id ON build_runs(build_id)
Index: idx_build_runs_plan_id ON build_runs(plan_id)
Added to MIGRATION_STATEMENTS with IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency

model.pattern: Same as existing CREATE_RUNS_TABLE — string constants, CHECK constraints for enums, CASCADE on FK deletes

steps.title: Add row types and converter functions for builds
steps.description: Define BuildRow and BuildRunRow interfaces in storage/sqlite/converters.ts. Implement rowToBuild() and rowToBuildRun() converter functions.

acceptance_criteria.description: BuildRow interface: { build_id: string, status: string, tiers_json: string, concurrency_limit: number, skip_completed: number, mode: string, workspace_path: string|null, error: string|null, created_at: string, started_at: string|null, completed_at: string|null, updated_at: string }
BuildRunRow interface: { build_id: string, run_id: string, plan_id: string, plan_version: number|null, tier: number, status: string, created_at: string, updated_at: string }
rowToBuild() parses tiers_json, converts skip_completed int→boolean, returns Build
rowToBuildRun() returns BuildRun directly (no JSON parsing needed)

architecture.pattern: Same as existing rowToRun() — parse JSON columns, convert int booleans, return typed entity

steps.title: Implement build CRUD storage functions
steps.description: Create storage/sqlite/builds.ts with all build storage operations: createBuild, getBuild, updateBuildStatus, listBuilds, createBuildRun, getBuildRunsByTier, updateBuildRunStatus, getRecentSuccessfulRun.

acceptance_criteria.description: createBuild(db, build: Build): Build — INSERT into builds with JSON.stringify(tiers), boolean→int conversion
getBuild(db, buildId): Build|null — SELECT with rowToBuild conversion
updateBuildStatus(db, buildId, status, error?): Build|null — UPDATE status + timestamps (started_at on running, completed_at on completed/failed/cancelled)
listBuilds(db, filter?: { status?, limit?, offset? }): { builds: Build[], total: number }
createBuildRun(db, buildRun: BuildRun): BuildRun — INSERT into build_runs
getBuildRunsByTier(db, buildId, tier): BuildRun[] — SELECT WHERE build_id AND tier
getBuildRunsForBuild(db, buildId): BuildRun[] — SELECT all build_runs for a build ordered by tier
updateBuildRunStatus(db, buildId, runId, status): BuildRun|null — UPDATE build_run status + updated_at
getRecentSuccessfulRun(db, planId): Run|null — SELECT from runs WHERE plan_id AND status='completed' ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1

Extend existing listRuns() to support plan_id filter: listRuns(filter?: { status?, plan_id?, limit?, offset? }). This enables Planner's ForgeClient to query GET /api/forge/runs?plan_id=X&status=completed.

file_edit: packages/forge-core/src/storage/interface.ts — extend listRuns signature to accept optional { plan_id, limit, offset } filter
packages/forge-core/src/storage/sqlite/runs.ts — update listRuns() to add WHERE plan_id = ? clause when filter.plan_id provided
architecture.pattern: Same as storage/sqlite/runs.ts — functions accept db: Database.Database, use prepared statements, parametrized queries

steps.title: Extend ForgeStorage interface with build methods
steps.description: Add build storage methods to the ForgeStorage interface and implement them in the SqliteForgeStorage class.

acceptance_criteria.description: ForgeStorage interface extended with: createBuild, getBuild, updateBuildStatus, listBuilds, createBuildRun, getBuildRunsByTier, getBuildRunsForBuild, updateBuildRunStatus, getRecentSuccessfulRun

Existing listRuns() signature updated: listRuns(filter?: { status?: RunStatus, plan_id?: string, limit?: number, offset?: number }): { runs: Run[], total: number }. Backwards compatible — no args returns all runs.
SqliteForgeStorage (storage/sqlite/index.ts) implements all new methods by delegating to builds.ts functions, and updates existing listRuns delegation
Build-related types imported and re-exported from storage/index.ts
